title: Add TransferFields SkipFieldsNotMatchingType guidance
summary: Added guidance in BCQuality to warn developers against using TransferFields with SkipFieldsNotMatchingType as a blanket solution, as it can silently drop fields when type mismatches occur within the same extension.
key_points: New knowledge rule explains that TransferFields only errors on type mismatches within the same extension, not cross-extension
Using SkipFieldsNotMatchingType to suppress errors can mask silent field drops
Good pattern: use explicit field-by-field mapping with Evaluate for type conversions to fail loudly
Bad pattern: relying on SkipFieldsNotMatchingType when destination needs all source fields copied
Rule includes code examples and verification against Microsoft Learn documentation
